verdicts.reason: All 16 blocks share one mechanism, verified by reproduction: the three units `test_check_diff_use_together`, `test_python315`, `test_python37` in `tests/test_black.py` receive phantom `ASSERT_REMOVED` findings on **any** edit to the file, including pure insertions and unrelated one-line changes. This is a frontend def-use binding artifact, not a property of the commits. Two commits (9e969ddc, 69973fd6) carry additional findings beyond the trio; those components are legitimate test adaptation (runner unification; blackd hardening with a constant pinned by a new test) and do not change the verdict.
